comment: Labels written for SlicerX in place of long or sentence-like Orca phrasing. Short standard terms (Layer height, Brim type, Wall loops) are kept as they are. Keys not listed take the knowledge catalog label or a readable form of the key.

labels.additional_fan_full_speed_layer: Layer where the auxiliary fan reaches full speed
labels.bed_mesh_max: Bed mesh probe area, far corner
labels.bed_mesh_min: Bed mesh probe area, near corner
labels.brim_ears_outer_only: Brim ears on the outside only
labels.calib_flowrate_topinfill_special_order: Special top infill order for flow tests
labels.close_additional_fan_first_x_layers: Auxiliary fan off for the first layers
labels.close_fan_the_first_x_layers: Fan off for the first layers
labels.complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed: Exhaust fan speed after the print
labels.cool_plate_temp: Bed temperature on the Cool Plate
labels.cool_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on the Cool Plate, first layer
labels.deretract_speed_extruder_change: Deretraction speed after an extruder change
labels.dont_slow_down_outer_wall: Do not slow down outer walls
labels.during_print_exhaust_fan_speed: Exhaust fan speed during the print
labels.elefant_foot_layers_density: Infill density of elephant foot layers
labels.enable_mixed_color_sublayer: Print mixed colors in thin sublayers
labels.enable_overhang_bridge_fan: Separate fan speed for overhangs and bridges
labels.enable_tower_interface_cooldown_during_t: Drop to print temperature at the start of the prime tower
labels.enable_wrapping_detection: Check for filament wrapping every layer
labels.eng_plate_temp: Bed temperature on the Engineering Plate
labels.eng_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on the Engineering Plate, first layer
labels.ensure_vertical_shell_thickness: Keep shells thick on steep sides
labels.fan_cooling_layer_time: Layer time below which the fan speeds up
labels.filament_change_length_nc: Filament change length on a nozzle change
labels.filament_cooling_before_tower: Nozzle cooling before the prime tower
labels.filament_loading_speed_start: Filament loading speed at the start
labels.filament_long_retractions_when_cut: Filament long retraction before a cut
labels.filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower: Smallest purge on the prime tower
labels.filament_multitool_ramming_flow: Ramming flow before a tool change
labels.filament_multitool_ramming_volume: Ramming volume before a tool change
labels.filament_pre_cooling_temperature: Nozzle cooling temperature before a filament change
labels.filament_pre_cooling_temperature_nc: Nozzle cooling temperature before a nozzle change
labels.filament_prime_volume_nc: Filament prime volume on a nozzle change
labels.filament_printable: Extruder types that can print this filament
labels.filament_ramming_travel_time_nc: Filament ramming travel time on a nozzle change
labels.filament_ramming_volumetric_speed_nc: Filament ramming speed on a nozzle change
labels.filament_retract_length_nc: Filament retraction length on a nozzle change
labels.filament_retract_length_toolchange: Filament retraction length at a tool change
labels.filament_retract_lift_above: Filament Z hop only above height
labels.filament_retract_lift_below: Filament Z hop only below height
labels.filament_retract_restart_extra_toolchang: Filament extra length on restart after a tool change
labels.filament_retract_when_changing_layer: Filament retract at each layer change
labels.filament_retraction_distances_when_cut: Filament retraction distance before a cut
labels.filament_retraction_minimum_travel: Filament shortest travel that triggers a retraction
labels.filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d: Prime tower pre-extrusion distance between materials
labels.filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l: Prime tower pre-extrusion length between materials
labels.filament_tower_interface_purge_volume: Prime tower purge length between materials
labels.filament_tower_ironing_area: Prime tower ironing area between materials
labels.filament_unloading_speed_start: Filament unloading speed at the start
labels.first_x_layer_fan_speed: Auxiliary fan speed for the first layers
labels.full_fan_speed_layer: Layer where the fan reaches full speed
labels.fuzzy_skin_layers_between_ripple_offset: Layers between fuzzy skin ripple shifts
labels.gcode_skip_config_block: Leave the settings block out of G-code
labels.hot_plate_temp: Bed temperature on the High Temperature plate or smooth PEI
labels.hot_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on the High Temperature plate or smooth PEI, first layer
labels.initial_layer_infill_speed: Infill speed on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_inner_wall_line_width: Inner wall line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_internal_solid_infill_line: Internal solid infill line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_line_width: Line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_min_bead_width: Narrowest wall line on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_outer_wall_line_width: Outer wall line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_sparse_infill_line_width: Sparse infill line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_support_line_width: Support line width on the first layer
labels.initial_layer_top_surface_line_width: Top surface line width on the first layer
labels.long_retractions_when_cut: Long retraction before a filament cut
labels.machine_bed_mass_Y: Bed mass on the Y axis
labels.machine_max_force_Y: Maximum force on the Y axis
labels.nozzle_temperature_initial_layer: Nozzle temperature for the first layer
labels.only_one_wall_first_layer: One wall on the first layer
labels.only_one_wall_top: Single wall on the top surface
labels.overhang_reverse_threshold: Overhang needed to reverse a wall
labels.parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas: Bed areas excluded for parallel heads
labels.prime_tower_enable_framework: Add ribs inside the prime tower
labels.prime_tower_skip_points: Leave an opening where each prime tower wipe starts
labels.reduce_fan_stop_start_freq: Avoid stopping the fan between layers
labels.relative_bridge_angle: Add bridge angle to the picked direction
labels.retract_length_toolchange: Retraction length at a tool change
labels.retract_restart_extra_toolchange: Extra length on restart after a tool change
labels.retraction_minimum_travel: Shortest travel that triggers a retraction
labels.role_based_wipe_speed: Wipe at the speed of the last line
labels.seam_slope_conditional: Scarf joint only on smooth loops
labels.seam_slope_entire_loop: Scarf joint along the whole loop
labels.separated_infills: Print the infill of each region separately
labels.single_extruder_multi_material_priming: Prime every filament along the bed front
labels.skirt_brim_edge: Measure skirt distance from the brim
labels.slow_down_for_layer_cooling: Slow printing on short layers to cool them
labels.slow_down_layers: Layers to ramp speed up over
labels.slow_down_min_speed: Slowest speed when cooling a layer
labels.spiral_finishing_flow_ratio: Flow ratio at the end of a vase
labels.spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing: Largest sideways shift when smoothing a vase
labels.spiral_starting_flow_ratio: Flow ratio at the start of a vase
labels.supertack_plate_temp: Bed temperature on the SuperTack plate
labels.supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on the SuperTack plate, first layer
labels.support_bottom_z_distance: Vertical gap between support and the part below
labels.support_interface_not_for_body: Keep interface filament out of the support body
labels.support_object_first_layer_gap: Gap between support and part on the first layer
labels.support_top_z_distance: Vertical gap between support and part
labels.symmetric_infill_y_axis: Mirror infill across the Y axis
labels.textured_cool_plate_temp: Bed temperature on the Textured Cool Plate
labels.textured_cool_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on the Textured Cool Plate, first layer
labels.textured_plate_temp_initial_layer: Bed temperature on textured PEI, first layer
labels.tool_change_on_wipe_tower: Change tools on the wipe tower
labels.toolchange_cyclic_first_layer: Cyclic tool changes on the first layer
labels.toolchange_ordering: Tool change order on each layer
labels.top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap: Top and bottom infill to wall overlap
labels.tree_support_auto_brim: Set the tree support brim size automatically
labels.wait_for_temp_on_wipe_tower: Wait for temperature on prime tower
labels.wipe_inward: Wipe inward at the end of a loop
labels.wipe_tower_bridging: Longest bridge in the prime tower
labels.wipe_tower_fillet_wall: Round the prime tower rib corners
labels.wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers: Skip prime tower layers without a tool change
labels.zaa_dont_alternate_fill_direction: Keep the fill direction the same on every layer
labels.zaa_minimize_perimeter_height: Slope angle for lowering top walls
